title: User
description: The user module displays the currently logged in user, the system uptime and, optionally, the user's avatar image.

placeholders.description: The login name of the currently logged in user, in uppercase
Whole days the system has been up
Hours part of the system uptime (00-23)
Minutes part of the system uptime (00-59)
Seconds part of the system uptime (00-59)
Day of the month the system was booted (01-31)

interval.label: Refresh every
interval.doc: The interval in which the information gets polled
interval.description: How often the module updates its information.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how the information should be displayed. See FORMAT REPLACEMENTS below
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

icon.label: Icon
icon.doc: When enabled, displays the user's avatar image next to the label
icon.description: When enabled, displays the user's avatar image next to the label

avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.doc: Path to the avatar image to display. Only used when icon is enabled. When unset, the default path $HOME/.face is used
avatar.description: Path to the avatar image to display. Only used when icon is enabled. When unset, the default path $HOME/.face is used

height.label: Height
height.doc: The height of the avatar image in pixels
height.description: The height of the avatar image in pixels

width.label: Width
width.doc: The width of the avatar image in pixels
width.description: The width of the avatar image in pixels

open-on-click.label: Open on click
open-on-click.doc: When enabled, left-clicking the module opens the user's home directory (or open-path) with the default file manager
open-on-click.description: When enabled, left-clicking the module opens the user's home directory (or open-path) with the default file manager

open-path.label: Open path
open-path.doc: Overrides the path that is opened when open-on-click is enabled. When empty, the user's home directory is used
open-path.description: Overrides the path that is opened when open-on-click is enabled. When empty, the user's home directory is used

rotate.label: Rotation
rotate.doc: Positive value to rotate the text label (in 90 degree increments)
rotate.description: Rotate the text. Mostly useful on vertical bars.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to enable tooltip on hover
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.
